description: This file defines the utility class ThreadUtil providing static methods for thread sleeping, running runnables in new threads, and running runnables as daemon threads.

classes.name: ThreadUtil
classes.description: A utility class for thread management, including sleep and runnable execution.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Pauses current thread execution for the specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the given Runnable in a new thread.

methods.name: runAsDaemon
methods.description: Executes the given Runnable in a new daemon thread.
